siteName: SBDMC, Inc. - Subic Bay Gateway Park
about: Subic Bay Gateway Park (SBGP) is a 45-hectare industrial park in the Subic Bay Freeport Zone, Philippines. Developed and operated by SBDMC, Inc. Designed for light manufacturing, logistics, warehousing, and BPO operations.

aboutDetails.history: SBDMC, Inc. was established in 1994 to develop, manage and market the Subic Bay Gateway Park (SBGP). It is a joint venture between the Subic Bay Metropolitan Authority (SBMA) and United Development Corporation (UDC) of Taiwan.
aboutDetails.mission: To develop and maintain a world-class industrial park that provides a competitive, sustainable, and business-friendly environment for locators, while contributing to the economic growth of the Subic Bay Freeport Zone and the Philippines.
aboutDetails.vision: To be the preferred industrial park of choice in the Asia-Pacific region, known for excellence in infrastructure, service, and environmental stewardship.

sbma.about: The Subic Bay Metropolitan Authority (SBMA) is the government agency responsible for the development and management of the Subic Bay Freeport Zone (SBFZ). Established in 1992 after the departure of the US military from Subic Bay Naval Base, the SBMA has transformed the area into one of the Philippines' most successful economic zones.
sbma.mandate: Administration, operation, and development of the Subic Bay Freeport Zone as a self-sustaining industrial, commercial, financial, and investment center.
functions: Investment Promotion — attracting and facilitating investments within the freeport zone
Infrastructure — developing and maintaining world-class infrastructure and facilities
Environmental Management — environmental protection and sustainable development programs

leasing.q: What types of businesses can locate in SBGP?
leasing.a: Light manufacturing, logistics and warehousing, BPO, commercial establishments, and service-oriented businesses.

leasing.q: What are the minimum and maximum lease terms?
leasing.a: Minimum lease term is 1 year. Longer terms are negotiable depending on the investment scale and building improvements.
Warehouse spaces range from 200 sqm to 5,000 sqm. Office spaces range from 50 sqm to 1,000 sqm. Custom configurations may be arranged.

leasing.q: What are the current lease rates?
leasing.a: Rates vary by location, unit type, and lease duration. Contact inquiry@sbdmc.com or call (047) 252-3456 for current rate sheet.
Sub-leasing requires prior written approval from SBDMC, Inc. The original lessee remains responsible for all lease obligations.

leasing.q: How do I apply for a lease?
leasing.a: Contact through the website contact page or visit the office at Argonaut Highway cor. Rizal Highway, Subic Bay Gateway Park. Call (047) 252-3456.

registration.q: How long does the business registration process take?
registration.a: Typically 2 to 4 weeks from lease application to full operation, depending on the complexity of the business.

registration.q: What are the steps to register a business in SBGP?
registration.a: 1) Submit lease application with business profile. 2) Sign lease contract. 3) Register with SBMA (Subic Bay Metropolitan Authority). 4) Obtain business permit and tax identification. 5) Set up utilities.

registration.q: What documents are required for registration?
registration.a: Business profile/company background, SEC or DTI registration, financial statements, business plan, list of directors/shareholders, and valid government IDs.
Yes, there are SBMA registration fees and local permit fees. Amounts vary by business type and scale. Contact inquiry@sbdmc.com for a detailed breakdown.

operations.a: Main gate operates 24/7. Visitor passes require a valid ID at the guardhouse. Truck entry is allowed during business hours (6 AM to 6 PM) with prior coordination.

operations.q: How do I get an RFID access pass?
operations.a: Submit an RFID application form (available at the guardhouse or via the website), provide valid ID and vehicle documents, pay the applicable fee, and attend a brief orientation. Processing takes 1-3 business days.

Visitors must present a valid government-issued ID at the main gate, register with the guardhouse, and be endorsed by the locator company they are visiting. Visitor passes are valid for the day of issue.

operations.q: What are the truck entry rules?
operations.a: Truck entry is allowed Monday to Saturday, 6 AM to 6 PM. Trucks must register in advance with the locator company. Oversized or hazardous cargo requires special permits.

operations.q: Do I need a permit for construction or renovations?
operations.a: Yes. Construction and renovation plans must be submitted to SBDMC for review and approval. A building permit from SBMA is also required. Allow 2-4 weeks for permit processing.

living.q: Is there housing near the park?
living.a: Yes. Nearby options include Subic Bay Town Center, Olongapo City (15 minutes away), and various subdivisions in Barrio Barretto and Baloy Beach area. Hotels and serviced apartments are also available for short-term stays.
Public jeepneys and tricycles operate between the park and Olongapo City. Shuttle services can be arranged for employees. Taxis and ride-hailing services (Grab) are available in the area.

living.q: Are there banks and ATMs nearby?
living.a: Yes. Banks with ATMs are located within the Subic Bay Freeport Zone, including BDO, Metrobank, BPI, and Landbank. Some are within a 5-minute drive from the park.

living.q: Is there a clinic or medical facility?
living.a: A medical clinic is located within the Subic Bay Freeport Zone. Olongapo City has several hospitals and medical centers, including James L. Gordon Memorial Hospital and St. Joseph's Hospital, about 15 minutes away.

living.q: Are there canteens or food options in the park?
living.a: Yes, there are canteens and food stalls within the park serving breakfast and lunch. Several restaurants and fast-food chains are available in Subic Bay Freeport Zone, a short drive from the park.

advantages.title: Strategic Location
advantages.description: Located in the heart of Asia's most dynamic region, with easy access to major markets and transportation hubs. 15 minutes from Olongapo City, 45 minutes from Clark International Airport, 2 hours from Metro Manila via NLEX-SCTEX.

advantages.title: Skilled Workforce
advantages.description: Access to a large pool of skilled, educated, and cost-competitive workers from Central Luzon. Sourced from Olongapo City and nearby towns with a labor force of approximately 500,000. Technical skills available through TESDA-accredited institutions.

advantages.title: World-Class Facilities
advantages.description: Modern infrastructure including reliable 24/7 power, adequate water supply, fiber optic telecom, well-maintained roads, and 24/7 security systems.

advantages.title: Growth Potential
advantages.description: No need for relocation when your company grows — there's no better deal elsewhere in Asia but right here in Subic. Space for expansion within the park.

advantages.title: Company Image & Customer Confidence
advantages.description: Join leading companies like Wistron, Taian, Taiwan Hitachi, TECO, and Tong Lung — all first-rate companies listed in the Taiwan Stock Exchange.

advantages.title: Security & Safety
advantages.description: 24/7 security monitoring, emergency response systems, and comprehensive safety protocols ensure your business operates securely.

infrastructure.power: Reliable 24/7 power supply with an on-site substation. Provider: Subic EnerZone. Backup generators available for critical operations. Rates are competitive with the national grid.
infrastructure.water: Adequate water supply from Subic Water. Water treatment facility on-site. Capacity sufficient for industrial and commercial use.
infrastructure.internet: High-speed fiber optic internet available through multiple providers including PLDT, Globe, and Converge. Speeds up to 1 Gbps can be arranged.
infrastructure.roads: Well-maintained paved roads within the park. Direct access to Argonaut Highway and Rizal Highway. Connecting to the Subic Bay Freeport Zone expressway network.
infrastructure.drainage: Modern drainage and flood control systems in place. Regular maintenance by the park management.

rates.leaseRanges: Warehouse: approximately PHP 150-300 per sqm/month. Office: approximately PHP 300-500 per sqm/month. Rates vary by location, condition, and lease duration.
rates.commonFees: Common area maintenance (CAM) fees apply. Utility deposits required. SBMA registration and permit fees are separate.
rates.note: Contact inquiry@sbdmc.com for a customized quotation based on your requirements.

types.title: Office Spaces

types.title: Land Leases

procedures.rfidApplication: 1) Obtain RFID application form from the guardhouse or website. 2) Complete the form with employee/vehicle details. 3) Submit with valid ID and vehicle registration (OR/CR). 4) Pay processing fee. 5) Attend brief RFID orientation. 6) Receive RFID sticker (1-3 business days).
procedures.businessRegistration: 1) Submit lease application and business profile to SBDMC. 2) Sign lease contract with SBDMC. 3) Register with SBMA — submit incorporating documents, business plan, and financial statements. 4) Obtain SBMA Certificate of Registration and Tax Exemption. 5) Secure business permit from SBMA. 6) Register with BIR for tax identification. 7) Set up utility connections (power, water, internet). Total: 2-4 weeks.
procedures.constructionPermit: 1) Submit building plans and specifications to SBDMC for review. 2) Obtain SBDMC construction clearance. 3) Apply for building permit with SBMA. 4) Secure necessary clearances (fire, sanitation, environmental). 5) Post construction bond. 6) Begin construction with regular inspections.

rfid.overview: All vehicles entering and exiting SBGP are required to have a valid RFID sticker, including cars, motorcycles, trucks, and other motor vehicles. This applies to locators, employees, tenants, and visitors.
rfid.validity: SBGP RFID is valid for one (1) year from the date of issuance/registration.
rfid.installation: RFID must be installed by authorized SBDMC, Inc. personnel on the non-metal part of the vehicle (headlight, fairings, visor).

fees.replacement: PHP 300.00 for lost or damaged RFID

requirements: For Direct Locators: Photocopy of OR/CR and Driver's License.
For Subleasees (SBGP Phase I and II): Photocopy of OR/CR and Driver's License.
For SBGP Employees: Photocopy of OR/CR, Driver's License, and SBMA ID.
For Gate Passers: Photocopy of OR/CR and Driver's License.
For Agency Employees: Photocopy of OR/CR, Driver's License, and Certificate of Employment (COE).
requirementNotes: If OR/CR does not match applicant's name, attach photocopy of Deed of Sale. Open Deed of Sale is not allowed.
If OR/CR belongs to a relative, indicate relationship on the photocopy.
Agency employees working inside SBGP need a Certificate of Employment (COE).
guidelines: Avoid tailgating — maintain one (1) car length distance between your vehicle and the next one.
Wait your turn — barrier closes after each vehicle. Wait until the boom arm fully lowers before proceeding.
SBDMC, Inc. has the right to block/confiscate RFID access of vehicles found with violations.
RFID stickers are non-transferable and non-refundable. Do not peel off and transfer to another vehicle.
dos: Maintain one (1) car length distance from the vehicle ahead
Wait for the boom arm to fully lower before proceeding
Keep your RFID sticker clean and intact
Report any RFID issues to the guard house or SBDMC, Inc. office
Renew your RFID before the 1-year validity expires
donts: Tailgate or follow closely behind another vehicle
Peel off or transfer the RFID sticker to another vehicle
Spray the RFID directly with a pressure washer
Use abrasive substances on the RFID sticker
Apply excessive force on the black chip at the middle of the RFID
rfid.damagePenalty: Damages to the boom arm will incur a PHP 15,000.00 penalty.
rfid.gateLocations: RFID checkpoints are installed at all entry and exit gates of Subic Bay Gateway Park.
rfid.applicationForm: RFID application forms are available at the guardhouse or via the SBDMC website.

parkLife.housing: Nearby residential options include Subic Bay Town Center residences, Olongapo City apartment complexes, Barrio Barretto subdivisions, and Baloy Beach area. Hotels: Subic Park Hotel, Subic Bay Yacht Club, and Court Meridian Hotel within 10-15 minutes.
parkLife.transportation: Public jeepneys and tricycles operate between SBGP and Olongapo City. Shuttle services available for locator employees. Grab ride-hailing operates in the area. Clark International Airport is 45 minutes away.
parkLife.banking: BDO, Metrobank, BPI, Landbank, and Asia United Bank have branches in Subic Bay Freeport Zone. ATMs available at each branch and select locations.
parkLife.medical: SBMA Medical Clinic within the freeport zone. James L. Gordon Memorial Hospital and St. Joseph's Hospital in Olongapo City (15 min). ACE Medical Center Subic in the freeport zone.
parkLife.dining: Canteens within the park. Numerous restaurants in Subic Bay Freeport Zone including SM Subic food court, Harbor Point dining options, and local eateries along Rizal Highway.

regulations.environmental: Locators must comply with SBMA environmental regulations. Environmental Compliance Certificate (ECC) may be required depending on business type. Waste management and disposal must follow SBMA guidelines.
regulations.wasteManagement: Segregation at source required. Hazardous waste disposal must be handled by accredited contractors. Regular waste collection by park management for non-hazardous waste.
regulations.safety: Occupational safety and health standards must be observed. Regular fire safety inspections conducted. Emergency response protocols in place with park security.
regulations.visitorPolicy: All visitors must register at the main gate, present valid ID, and be endorsed by the host locator company. Visitor passes valid for one day only.

gateHours: Main gate operates 24/7. Visitor passes require a valid ID at the guardhouse. Truck entry is allowed during business hours (6 AM to 6 PM) with prior coordination.
workforce: Sourced from Olongapo City and nearby towns with a labor force of approximately 500,000. Technical skills are available through local vocational schools and training centers including TESDA-accredited institutions.
mapRoute: Located in the Subic Bay Freeport Zone. 15 minutes from Olongapo City, 45 minutes from Clark International Airport, and approximately 2 hours from Metro Manila via NLEX-SCTEX.
